changelog: Hardening bundle (Phase 35-39 productionization). (A) AuditLog::record wired across all new privileged endpoints: cashier_shift.open/close/encash, order.refund, vsd.accept/reject, egais.invoice.accept/reject, egais.bottle_open, odata.creds.rotate/enable/disable, aggregator.settings.save, aggregator.secret.rotate, aggregator.webhook.received, aggregator.webhook.rate_limited. Caller-side только AuditLog::record(action, target_type, target_id, meta); audit_log table уже существует. (B) lib/RateLimiter.php — file-based fixed-window per-bucket counter (data/cache/ratelimit/<sha>.json) с fail-open поведением. Применён в api/aggregator/webhook.php: 60 запросов/мин per (provider + client_ip) → 429 + Retry-After + audit_log entry. (C) Loosened type hints в AggregatorAdapter::normalize и impl'ах: \Database → object (duck-typed для unit tests; production использует real Database). (D) Tests: AggregatorAdapterTest (HMAC verify positive/negative/empty/truncated + normalize + mapStatusOutbound + statusPushUrl) и ODataQueryParserTest ($top/$skip clamping + $select whitelist + $filter eq/gt/substringof/datetime/bool + reject unknown field/operator + PDO-param prefix invariant). Lock invariants vs SQL injection drift.
